title: Add deterministic test scenario artifacts
problem: KBL-025 showed that generic QA can pass while critical behavior is still broken. The add-issue --from-json implementation passed compile, qa, validate-json, and diff checks, but only a human-designed temp repo behavior test exposed the argparse required-fields bug. Kajiya Build Line needs durable, repo-agnostic test scenario artifacts so humans/chats can define exactly what QA must verify.
expected_behavior: Kajiya Build Line supports durable test scenario artifacts under docs/test-scenarios/*.json. These artifacts describe deterministic setup, input files, commands, expected JSON fields, and cleanup/escalation policy. The artifacts are schema-governed and can later be executed by a deterministic QA runner.
proposed_change: Add docs/test-scenarios/KBL-025-add-issue-from-json.json as the first scenario artifact based on the temp repo test that caught the argparse bug.
Document that humans/chats own QA design and Pi/CLI executes QA deterministically.
Do not implement the test runner yet; this issue only creates the durable test scenario contract and validation gate.
close_criteria: KBL-025 add-issue --from-json temp repo scenario exists as a JSON artifact.
Existing validation for project profile, task briefs, and upstream improvements still passes.
Evidence documents why generic QA was insufficient for KBL-025.
